fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-bba5fe8b at fb81edc3: read the diff (internal/api/inbox.go drops the st.Autonomous condition so any plan run's Gated change sets still proposed list as accept items, unless a newer run retried the change set) and the new cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/inbox-owner-run-accept.txtar, which sets rhiza.autonomy.accept owner, gates a non-autonomous plan run (asserts "autonomous": false), shows rhiza inbox --json listing kind accept with detail 'waiting for acceptance' and next 'rhiza accept --rule owner --change <id>', then after rhiza accept --rule owner shows no accept item, and passes fold-ok. Ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -count=1 -run TestScripts/(inbox-.*|owner-run-gate-accept|plan-workflow-autonomous.*|run-gate|autonomous-gate-rule|tui-inbox-app|autonomy-accept-rule|stage-autonomy): ok. stage-autonomy still lists the autonomous plan's accept items under accept owner. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run Inbox: ok. (The whole internal/api package hit go test's 10m timeout once while the machine ran several other suites at the same time; the inbox tests pass when run on their own.)
